# `apps/realmforge/modeler/viewport/RealmForgeSDFExtrudedGeometry.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/apps/realmforge/modeler/viewport/RealmForgeSDFExtrudedGeometry.js`

Exact boundary proof for a closed, untapered Z extrusion, including holes.

## Functions

### `recognizeRealmForgeSDFExtrusion(mesh)`

Accept the uploaded triangles only when both caps describe the same disjoint planar region and every exposed cap edge has exactly its closed vertical wall. No hull, bounds envelope, tolerance weld, or inferred hole repairs are used.

## Constants

- `REALMFORGE_SDF_MAX_PROFILE_EDGES` — Exact boundary proof for a closed, untapered Z extrusion, including holes.
